`enum UniformType`<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.bridge.render.shader.uniform` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [UniformType.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/bridge/render/shader/uniform/UniformType.java)

The GLSL types that a uniform can have, with the component and column counts that set its std140 size and the values that it accepts.

## Description

[`UniformMember`](/reference/pipeline/uniformmember/) uses the type to lay the member out and to check each value: the integer types take `int` values, `bool` and `int` also take `boolean` values, and the float types take floats or integers.
Samplers are not in this list: they become [`UniformSampler`](/reference/pipeline/uniformsampler/) objects.

## Learn more

- [Pick a uniform layout](/build/shader-translation/#pick-a-uniform-layout)

<a id="UniformType-methods"></a>

## Methods

| Returns | Signature | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| `boolean` | [isMatrix](#UniformType-method-isMatrix)() | If `true`, the type is a square matrix, laid out as columns of 16 bytes. |
| `int` | [getCount](#UniformType-method-getCount)() | Returns the number of 32-bit values in one element: the components times the columns, `16` for a `mat4`. |
| `String` | [getIdentifier](#UniformType-method-getIdentifier)() | Returns the GLSL name of the type, such as `vec3`. |
| `int` | [getComponents](#UniformType-method-getComponents)() | Returns the number of components of a scalar or a vector, or the number of rows of a matrix. |
| `int` | [getColumns](#UniformType-method-getColumns)() | Returns the number of columns of a matrix, or `0` for a scalar or a vector. |
| `boolean` | [isInteger](#UniformType-method-isInteger)() | If `true`, the type stores integers (`int`, `uint`, `bool` and their vectors) and refuses floats. |

## Values

| Value | Summary |
|---|---|
| [`INT`](#UniformType-value-INT) | `int`, a signed integer. |
| [`UINT`](#UniformType-value-UINT) | `uint`, an unsigned integer, which needs GLSL 1.30. |
| [`BOOL`](#UniformType-value-BOOL) | `bool`, stored as the integer `0` or `1`. |
| [`FLOAT`](#UniformType-value-FLOAT) | `float`. |
| [`VEC2`](#UniformType-value-VEC2) | `vec2`, two floats. |
| [`VEC3`](#UniformType-value-VEC3) | `vec3`, three floats, aligned on 16 bytes. |
| [`VEC4`](#UniformType-value-VEC4) | `vec4`, four floats. |
| [`IVEC2`](#UniformType-value-IVEC2) | `ivec2`, two signed integers. |
| [`IVEC3`](#UniformType-value-IVEC3) | `ivec3`, three signed integers. |
| [`IVEC4`](#UniformType-value-IVEC4) | `ivec4`, four signed integers. |
| [`UVEC2`](#UniformType-value-UVEC2) | `uvec2`, two unsigned integers. |
| [`UVEC3`](#UniformType-value-UVEC3) | `uvec3`, three unsigned integers. |
| [`UVEC4`](#UniformType-value-UVEC4) | `uvec4`, four unsigned integers. |
| [`BVEC2`](#UniformType-value-BVEC2) | `bvec2`, two booleans stored as integers. |
| [`BVEC3`](#UniformType-value-BVEC3) | `bvec3`, three booleans stored as integers. |
| [`BVEC4`](#UniformType-value-BVEC4) | `bvec4`, four booleans stored as integers. |
| [`MAT2`](#UniformType-value-MAT2) | `mat2`, a 2×2 float matrix, written column by column. |
| [`MAT3`](#UniformType-value-MAT3) | `mat3`, a 3×3 float matrix, written column by column. |
| [`MAT4`](#UniformType-value-MAT4) | `mat4`, a 4×4 float matrix, written column by column. |

## Creation details

<a id="UniformType-factory-of"></a>

### of

`UniformType of(String identifier)` <span class="joid-qualifier">factory</span>

**Throws:**

- `IllegalArgumentException`: The uniform type … is not supported, use int, uint, bool, float, vec2 to vec4, ivec2 to ivec4, uvec2 to uvec4, bvec2 to bvec4 or mat2 to mat4

Returns the type with this GLSL name.
Throws `IllegalArgumentException` for a type outside this list, such as a struct.
